\section{\texttt{index\_write\_lock}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.index_persistence.index_write_lock}\index{Functions!index\_write\_lock}

Lock a canonical index path across threads and processes, yielding that path.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
index_write_lock(path: str | Path, *, timeout: float = 60.0) -> Iterator[Path]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{path}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required.
  \item[\texttt{timeout}] \texttt{float}, default \texttt{60.\allowbreak{}0}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{Iterator[Path]\allowbreak{}}
\apifield{Details}Hold this lock across the entire read/modify/write operation. Nested calls on the same thread are reentrant, including saves inside an update. The sidecar \texttt{\textless{}index\textgreater{}.\allowbreak{}lock} belongs to the locking library; do not remove it while processes may use the index. Lock acquisition failures retain file context in \texttt{FileWriteError}. Locks require a cooperating local filesystem.
